The image contains a watermark, which is a logo or text that is overlaid on top of the image. The watermark is typically used to identify the source of the image or to provide additional information about the image.

In this case, the watermark is located in the center of the image and appears to be a circular logo with the text "com" written in it. The watermark is semi-transparent, which means that it does not completely obscure the underlying image.

Overall, the presence of a watermark in an image can be useful for identifying the source of the image or for providing additional context about the image. However, it can also be distracting or annoying if it is not properly designed or placed.
